name: Undying Salvation
body:
Your spirits can save you from the brink of death.

Prerequisite(s): Undying Aid, occultist 10.

Benefit(s): Once per day, whenever you would be slain you can immediately expel all spirits you are bound to (as if through Expel Spirits) in order to cast breath of life upon yourself. Your caster level equals your binder level for this effect, and you do not need to be conscious in order to use this binder secret.
